news.title: Republicans pick minority leadership for House for first time in a generation
news.snippet: Georgia House Republicans elected Rep. Todd Jones minority leader and James Burchett minority whip. Senate Democrats kept Harold Jones II as minority leader.

news.title: Georgia House GOP picks Todd Jones as minority leader
news.snippet: Georgia House Republicans chose their minority leadership team; Jon Burns was named speaker emeritus.

news.title: Carolyn Hugley poised to become Georgia's first Black female House speaker
news.snippet: Georgia House Democrats picked their leadership team for the 2027 session.

news.title: Hugley is officially nominated as Georgia House speaker as Democrats choose their leaders
news.snippet: Georgia House Democrats nominated Rep. Carolyn Hugley for Speaker, Billy Mitchell for Speaker Pro Tem, Stacey Evans as majority leader and Sam Park as majority whip. The full House votes Jan. 11. The speaker appoints committee leaders.

news.title: Democrats select new leadership for state House
news.snippet: The speaker selects chairs of the 44 House committees; naming them would be among Hugley's first tasks after her January confirmation.

news.title: Georgia Democrats make historic nomination for Speaker of the House
news.snippet: Georgia House Democrats nominated Carolyn Hugley as speaker; Senate Republicans named Larry Walker III as president pro tempore nominee and kept Jason Anavitarte as majority leader.
